parameters.name: page_size
parameters.description:
Maximum items to return. The server may return fewer, and returning
fewer never means the collection is exhausted — only an absent
`next_page_token` means that.

parameters.name: page_token
parameters.description:
The `next_page_token` from the previous response. Opaque: its contents
are not part of the contract and must not be constructed, parsed, or
persisted by a client.
